title: Par-exit front-run on the migration cushion: story-020 turns the FCFS underwater buffer into a value transfer from the remaining cohort
novelty: RE-RAISE of a wont-fix (new fingerprint, LINKED)
description: While Active, _routeExit's underwater branch pays a departing staker at par out of the buffer B2 and relinquishes the claim without moving shares. initiateMigration then snapshots R = balanceOf(this) against a B2 reduced by exactly that payout, so every remaining staker's pro-rata credit falls.
impact: Exact zero-sum transfer between users. Worked example: the front-runner goes 95e6 -> 100e6 and the remaining cohort goes 855e6 -> 850e6. Protocol balance sheet unaffected.
attackPath: 3. Any staker whose position <= B2 front-runs the mempool with withdraw(full position).
4. _routeExit's underwater branch pays them at par out of B2 and relinquishes the claim without moving shares.
5. initiateMigration snapshots R against the reduced B2; every remaining staker's pro-rata credit falls.
recommendation: Zero-code-change runbook step: pause() -> initiateMigration() -> unpause(). withdraw is whenNotPaused; initiateMigration is not. This is strictly narrower than the two fixes the owner previously rejected.

disclosure.priorTitle: Underwater withdraw buffer is FCFS at par, socializing strategy loss onto slow stakers
disclosure.triageReasonQuoted: Intended design (confirmed by protocol owner) ... bank-run / mass-exit is handled separately by migrateOut with pro-rata distribution. The report itself concedes there is no incremental victim (the slow staker is baseline-unchanged vs a no-buffer world).
disclosure.reFileBasis: story-020 falsified the emphasised clause. Under V1 the buffer never entered the migration payout, so a slow staker's credit was identical with or without it. Under V2, R = balanceOf(this) puts B2 into the pro-rata pool, so the incremental victim now demonstrably exists and is quantified.
disclosure.conceded: The FIRST clause of the closure (par exits during transient dips avoid forcing loss realisation) is NOT disputed.
disclosure.routing: Human re-triage at /ledger. Never to be filed as a naive new discovery.

exposureWindow: STRICTLY the pre-Migrating window. Tier-3 INV-3 proved that once Migrating is latched, allocation is pro-rata and bit-identical under any batch composition or ordering - there is no in-Migrating leg.
